_comment: Human-facing optimizer input for the canonical V3 pipeline. Search ranges, objective weights, Optuna internals, warmup, per-stage trial budgets, seeds and storage paths are automatic and deliberately not exposed here.
_history_comment: Choose history.mode: auto | days | date_range | candles. Only fields required by the chosen mode may be non-null. Warmup candles are added automatically and are not part of the requested history.
_execution_comment: tick_size is "auto" (resolved from Binance Futures PRICE_FILTER.tickSize for this symbol) or a positive number validated against that same metadata. The quantity step is always resolved automatically from LOT_SIZE.stepSize.
_trials_comment: TOTAL trials across all five V3 stages. 1850 allocates exactly 400/800/200/300/150. "auto" picks a documented total from timeframe and history length; the run plan prints the five budgets before anything runs.
